card.name: Small words in stock label phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words in fixed label sentences: "contact" after "To report SUSPECTED ADVERSE REACTIONS,", "of" after "increased risk", and "have" after "more likely to". Also a dash after a JEL classification code.

modes.label: Adverse reaction reporting line
modes.description: The word "contact" right after the instruction to report suspected adverse reactions.
modes.example: To report SUSPECTED ADVERSE REACTIONS,<< contact>> Winder Laboratories, LLC at 1

modes.label: Elderly dementia warning
modes.description: "of" after "increased risk" in the antipsychotic dementia-related psychosis warning.
modes.example: treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk<< of>> death. GEODON is not approved

modes.label: Elderly renal function sentence
modes.description: "have" after "elderly patients are more likely to" in the kidney-function statement.
modes.example: Because elderly patients are more likely to<< have>> decreased renal function, care should be taken
